english.note: Use this casually in a shop for the transaction slip, though it can also mean the bill or order rather than specifically proof of payment.
This is the everyday all-purpose choice for a bill or invoice, especially in casual conversation.
Use 單 for an official or printed paper slip such as a payslip or form.
